description: This file defines the main client-side component for the 'Explore' section in a Next.js app, including UI state, filters, search handling, and rendering of role recommendations and mindmaps.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: A utility function to normalize a value into a trimmed string.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value into a safe array of trimmed, non-empty strings.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses various salary fields from a role object into a min-max range in lakhs.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts the role title from a role object, considering various possible field names.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Determines whether a role matches the current filters including industry, skills, salary, and title query.
